prompt: An IR shows a very broad O–H (2500–3300 cm⁻¹) overlapping with C–H, plus a C=O at 1710. The functional group is:

options.label: Carboxylic acid (characteristic very broad O–H + C=O)

explanation: The very broad O–H (from hydrogen-bonded carboxylic acid dimers) spanning 2500–3300 overlapping with C–H is COOH-specific. Combined with the C=O at ~1710, that's a diagnostic COOH pattern. Alcohols have a narrower O–H at 3200–3550.
